content: And btw, the tech industry should help me. Mike Arrington said one day they would erect a statue of me in Palo Alto or San Jose. I told him it'll never happen because I knew how tight the Silicon Valley club was. I was on the edge of it for many years, and for brief periods I was inside. He saw me at the peak. But their model and mine were radically different. I saw software as an individual thing, that it's like making a movie, and you need various skills, and we all work together, and make something great out of cooperation. That's what the web calls us to do. They just fucked it up so bad that The Web isn't the web any longer. No problem, we'll make a new one.
